patthana12.14:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na hetusampayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana12.14:2.1: na saraṇaṃ na hetuvippayuttaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana12.14:3.1: na saraṇaṃ na hetuñceva na ahetukañca dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ ahetukañceva na na ca hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na hetuñceva na hetuvippayuttañca dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na hetuvippayuttañceva na na ca hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana12.14:4.1: na saraṇaṃ na hetuṃ na sahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-.
patthana12.14:5.1: na saraṇaṃ na hetuṃ na ahetukaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na saraṇaṃ na appaccayaṃ
